screening_attempts.quarantine_resolution_reason: Released under screening policy v13 after operator source review of Hades v21 (a5992483, SHA 2408e538...5401e62, attempt da21c338). The hold, l2-model-inconclusive, has no adjudicated finding (finding=null): L2/L3 returned no usable result and no budget limit tripped. Every L1 note is an I5 benchmark_emulation lead on app/short.py:101-105,277-288 and app/guide_records.py:42-53,196. They are refuted. (1) Filed-order program path (short.py:182-205 filed_view, 159-171 revert_lines, 105 FILED_ORDER_NOTE): notes sorted by saved time and shown in full with their stamps, plus an unchecked host note naming which entry a revert or declined proposal takes back ("the notes decide wherever they differ"). This is the case-file currency safe harbor (policy-v13 I5 clarification 2026-10-23: change vocabulary matching public generator rows and a host current/supersedes note are permitted). The same revert_lines/FILED_ORDER_NOTE was released for Hades v17 and passed for v18; v21 only adds DECLINED_RE (short.py:150-151), the same kind of note. It points to a record and does not compute or serve a value, so it is not the 10-24 generator-parser ground. The "Bench 14" comment (short.py:101) is not behavior: there is no bench_version branch. (2) guide_records.py record_notes/program_notes/notes (196-247): regex-routed advisory prompt notes, with common rules only and no benchmark-private content. This is the routed-guidance safe harbor (2026-10-23). (3) The reused draft and earlier reply (short.py:285-288 SHARED_DRAFT_NOTE; 624-644 repeat_reply, keyed per user, same notes and same question) reach the model only as prompt text. outcome.content is always model-authored (records.py:519-599, action.py:559-626, short.py:641), with parse_slot plus request-independent W8 bold-strip typography (agent.py:224). There is no host compare, retry, overwrite or substitution (I4 clarification 2026-10-29). (4) The v19 I4 ground (host-selected dated email, agent.py:155,178,224 evidence_view/answer_from_view) is removed. dated_emails (guide_records.py:134-159) now lists every matching passage with its date and leaves the reading to the model, a good-faith fix. (5) The new revocation.py:43-107 blocks a call only after two model readings say the user's own message withdrew that tool. Quotations and negation scope are handled in the prompt, a missing reading withdraws nothing, and blocked calls are never reported as executed (tools.py:148-150). This is W4/W11 explicit no-tool handling, not I7. Lineage: same owner as scored Hades v18 and released v17, zero duplicates, no copy hold.
